verified_diagnosis.issue: The B0 final mini_val evaluation has not been run
verified_diagnosis.evidence: Only one B0 run exists; its provenance mode is train, checkpoint_path is null, validation is the mini_train dev partition, and no proposal/tracking export exists.
verified_diagnosis.implication: No B0-vs-B1/SeqTrack final-test delta or paired bootstrap can yet be reported.

verified_diagnosis.issue: CT22 B0 changes both data budget and state distribution relative to SeqTrack
verified_diagnosis.evidence: CT22 uses 855 steps/epoch and 51,300 total steps on the 70% train partition; SeqTrack uses 1,262 steps/epoch and 75,720 total steps on all mini_train, a 32.25% step reduction. CT22 also trains on recursive learner states with reseed horizons 1/2/4/8.
verified_diagnosis.implication: A lower B0 score would not isolate architecture quality; data-budget and exposure-distribution effects remain confounded.

verified_diagnosis.issue: The repaired rollout still under-covers deployment-length drift
verified_diagnosis.evidence: The maximum learner age is seven steps because every training slot reseeds at H<=8, whereas inference does not reseed and mini_val tracklets average 21.56 frames.
verified_diagnosis.implication: B0 can become good at short recovery windows but remain weak after long recursive drift.

verified_diagnosis.issue: Historical high scores are direct B0 outputs but not proof that pure B0-only training was high
verified_diagnosis.evidence: CT21 Full and B2-only applied zero Search actions at mini_val, so final boxes were observation boxes. However B2 consumes the non-detached observation query and its auxiliary losses backpropagate through shared observation features; recursive Search writeback can also change later B0 crops during training.
verified_diagnosis.implication: The historical gain may be indirect multi-task regularization or training-state coupling, not inference-time Search.

verified_diagnosis.issue: Current ablations are not optimization-equivalent even when their deployed output is observation-only
verified_diagnosis.evidence: B0 and B1-only differ by B1/prepass and B3 flags; B1-only inherits ct_enable_b3=true, enabling the shadow-data path although B2 is off. Their dev trajectories differ materially despite no deployed Search action.
verified_diagnosis.implication: Before causal module claims, a deterministic shared-B0 parameter-equivalence smoke test and a clean B1-only config with B3 disabled are required.

verified_diagnosis.issue: B0 cannot currently expose the state diagnostics required by the repair plan
verified_diagnosis.evidence: ct_recursive_state_age, reset, anchor-error and crop-target-point logging is nested inside the ct_enable_b2 loss branch; B0 and B1-only therefore do not emit those diagnostics.
verified_diagnosis.implication: The most important state-distribution hypothesis cannot be tested from the completed B0 logs.

decision_sequence.action: Run exactly one frozen B0 mini_val test from epoch=29-step=25650.ckpt
decision_sequence.purpose: Complete the matched CT22 baseline without selecting on mini_val

decision_sequence.action: Compare B1-only and B1+B2 against that B0 with whole-tracklet paired bootstrap
decision_sequence.purpose: Separate observation-training effects from direct Search effects
decision_sequence.promotion_gate: Report deltas and 95% CIs; do not infer from dev curves

decision_sequence.action: Add state diagnostics outside the B2 branch and clean B1-only by explicitly disabling B3/shadow
decision_sequence.purpose: Make B0/B1 ablations auditable and semantically pure
decision_sequence.promotion_gate: B0 and B1-only share identical candidate0 inputs and B0 parameter updates in a deterministic short smoke test

decision_sequence.action: Run a seed42 B0 old-recursive/no-reseed control against repaired B0
decision_sequence.purpose: Test whether short reseeds caused the observation ceiling
decision_sequence.promotion_gate: 60-epoch dev-selected frozen mini_val comparison; short runs are diagnostics only

decision_sequence.action: If long rollout restores B0, decouple B0 crop rollout from B1 motion-label history
decision_sequence.purpose: Keep B0 exposure robustness while preventing B1 label contamination
decision_sequence.promotion_gate: B0 non-regression plus B1 RMSE better than fallback on deployment-like histories

decision_sequence.action: Redesign Search acquisition before more Full seeds
decision_sequence.purpose: Move from geometric validity to target-bearing new support
decision_sequence.promotion_gate: Calibration evidence-valid coverage >=5%, target-extension-positive rows nonzero, helpful precision >=75%, harm <=5%

method.metrics: TensorBoard EventAccumulator over success/test and precision/test; 12 validations at epochs 5..60
method.integrity: run_provenance, checkpoint inventory, finite full-step loss scans, config diff and source-path audit
method.comparison_rule: dev metrics are compared only among CT22 runs using the same 37-tracklet partition; historical mini_val values are context, not causal matched deltas
method.uncertainty: B0 paired bootstrap is unavailable until its independent mini_val endpoint result exists
